services.name: Summer Camp: June 1-28, 2026
services.desc: Our theatre summer camp is a fun, creative way for your child to build confidence, enhance communication skills, form lasting friendships, and develop or improve theatrical skills. This summer, camp will be held from 1pm-5pm, for students ages 12-17. We will use a variety of theatre games, improvisation, role playing, scene work, dance and vocal training; while rehearsing the show Anything Goes: Youth Edition. Campers will discover the techniques actors use to win the hearts and minds of audiences and which will help them shine in other areas of their lives off the stage. The best part of all is that camp will culminate with a full staged production of the show with three performances over

blurb: Starting August 2026, Theatre Tallahassee is launching a year-round education program with something for nearly every age and interest. Just in time for the fall semester, we will be offering After-School classes for students in grades 3-12. These are ongoing, weekly theatrical education classes, that will culminate at the end of each semester with a showcase performance.
